# Diani Splash Kids Water Park

Diani Splash Kids is a premier family water park and restaurant located in Diani Beach, Kwale County, Kenya. Designed specifically for children ages 3 to 15, the facility offers a safe, fun, and engaging environment with a variety of wet and dry activities.

## Core Information
- **Location:** Diani Beach Road, Galu Beach - Salama Villas No. 1, Near Neptune Hotels, Diani Beach, Kenya
- **Phone:** +254 114 150 622
- **Website:** https://diani-splash-kids.com/
- **Opening Hours:** Water Park: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM daily. Restaurant: 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM daily.

## Key Features & Activities
- **Water Attractions:** Six towers, multiple slides (wave, tube, spiral), paddling pools, and toddler splash zones.
- **Dry Land Activities:** Bouncy castles, mini-cars (ages 3-5), robots, hoverboards, indoor games, and billiards.
- **The Splash Kitchen & Bar:** A full-service on-site restaurant serving brick-oven pizzas, bistro classics, fast food, and tropical drinks. Free pizza delivery within a 5km radius.
- **Birthday Parties:** Specialized in hosting children's birthday parties with dedicated packages, decorations, and entertainment.

## Pricing Structure
- Sliding Area (Pool Side): KES 1,000 (Per day)
- Toddlers Splash (Ages 3-5): KES 800 (Per day)
- Indoor Games: KES 500 (Per day)
- Robots / Hover Boards / Mini Cars: KES 200 - 300 (per 10 mins)
- Floaters Rental: KES 200 (Per day)
- Bicycles: KES 100 (per 20 mins)

## Target Audience
Families visiting or living in Diani Beach, Kenya, looking for safe, dedicated children's entertainment and high-quality dining options.
